rules.accepted_credit_types: Providers recognized or approved by ANCC/ANA, NCSBN, AHECs, state nurses associations, NLN, NAPNES, NFLPN, licensed health facilities, health care provider associations, accredited colleges, government agencies, AHA/ASHI/Red Cross (advanced resuscitation), or any state board of nursing
rules.alternatives: 30 contact hours is one of nine options; one is enough, e.g. national specialty certification, 3 credit hours of post-licensure academic education, a Board-approved refresher course, an evidence-based practice project, a publication, teaching a nursing course or CE, or 15 contact hours plus 640 hours of active practice.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt for the first renewal after initial licensure by examination or endorsement.
rules.audit_note: Keep original documentation 2 years after renewal and provide it within 30 days of a Board request (18VAC90-19-170).
rules.notes: Renewal by the last day of the birth month, in even or odd years matching the birth year. Dual RN/LPN licensees meet one requirement. Extension up to 1 year on request 60 days before renewal.
